name: hooks-worktrunk
description: Enforces Worktrunk as the worktree-management interface for Claude and Codex. A cross-runtime PreToolUse guard denies direct git worktree and gh pr checkout commands with the equivalent wt command, while steering and config templates cover official plugins, agent checkout isolation, lifecycle hook ownership, repository-scoped build targets, copy-ignored warm starts, deterministic dev-server ports, aliases, and LLM commit generation.
